summary: OVNI persona round 5 fixer: battle and campaign sim/data balance

fix.api:
TUNE (new):
- ALIEN_DAMAGE_PCT [50,100,100]
- BASE_DEFENCE_WEAPON_PCT 50, BASE_DEFENCE_GUN_BASE 30, BASE_DEFENCE_GUN_CAP 120
- BASE_DEFENCE_RATIO_LO/MID/HI 50/100/150
- BASE_DEFENCE_HOLD_CASUALTY_PCT 60, BASE_DEFENCE_HOLD_FACILITIES 2

TUNE (changed): ALIEN_BASE_SURRENDER ['commander','leader'] (was ['commander','leader','leader']).

Data:
- Data.crewRules gains kinds {ufo:1, terror:1} and earlyRowDelta {terror:{terrorist:-1}}.
- New Data.crewQty(depId, row, diff, month) → [min,max]. Battle.create and Data.deploymentRange use it.

OV.Battle:
- exitWin(B) → bool: an alien base whose OBJECTIVE tiles are all destroyed; aborting now wins.
- clusteredDeaths(B) → int: X-COM dead killed outside the X-COM turn with another X-COM death in the same turn ≤ 2 tiles away.
- outcome(B): destroying the alien-base objective no longer ends the battle (Cydonia still ends on the Brain). For an aborted battle it returns 'win' when B.result is 'win'.
- abort(B) → {survivors, mia, craftLost, result:'win'|'abort'}. B.result is 'win' when exitWin(B) and someone conscious is aboard.
- debrief(B) gains clustered:int. On an aborted win, recovery follows the abort rules: only what is aboard or carried, no base artefacts, no garrison leftovers, mind-controlled aliens only if aboard.

Units: unit.deathTile is set on death.

OV.Path.flyRoute(B, from, to, opts): opts.side 'xcom' restricts every route tile except the target to tiles that are visible or discovered (map.disc & 1). Act.validate (guided shoot) and Combat's guided path pass {side: shooter.side}.

OV.Combat.damageUnit: damage from an alien-side attacker to an X-COM unit (origSide 'xcom') is scaled by ALIEN_DAMAGE_PCT[difficulty]. No RNG is consumed.

OV.Campaign:
- defenderPower(soldier, gunPower?) → tu + fire + hp + front armour + floor((gun − 30) × 50 / 100). gun defaults to the best usable gun in the soldier's hands.
- defenceOdds(G, baseId, {ufoId?|race?}?) → {garrison, strength, need, ratio, lostPct, repelPct, holdPct, race, ufoType, men, facilities, defences, soldiersShort, defencesShort}. Pure. Without ufoId it assumes an intact Battleship of the race of the retaliation targeting the base, or else the strongest race of the month. defencesShort is −1 when Missile Defences alone cannot close the gap.
- baseDefence(G, baseId, ufoId) → {result, shots, soldiersLost, held, facilitiesDamaged, odds}. One combat-stream roll int(0,99) against lostPct / repelPct / holdPct.
  - result 'repelled' with held:true: at least 60 % of the garrison dies (someone survives), up to 2 radars/defences go back to construction (daysLeft = days), no score.
  - The baseDefence event gains odds {ratio, lostPct, repelPct, holdPct}, plus held:true and facilitiesDamaged:[type] when held.
- kitGuns(G, stores) → [itemId]: order for the auto-kit. Rifles best first, then two-handed heavies with usable ammo by power, then pistols. No stun weapons, no Blaster, nothing unresearched.
- finishMission: the alien-base surrender is now the base's command post, one per rank of ALIEN_BASE_SURRENDER. It happens only on a win with no conscious alien left (not deb.objective, not B.aborted) and does not depend on B.crew. model.surrendered is unchanged in shape.

tools/sim.js campaign summary counts 'held' base defences; the campaign bot logs the ratio of each base attack.
fix.summary:
I fixed five of the six findings in r5_fixS.json at the root. Finding 1 (pistols chosen over the stored Rocket Launchers) is fixed only in the sim: the new `OV.Campaign.kitGuns` gives the right gun order, but `js/ui/campaign_ui.js` must still use it, and that file belongs to the shell fixer (patch in open_issues). Finding 4 is fixed in a different way from the persona's proposal, explained below.

`node tools/test.js --strict --i18n`: 835 passed, 0 failed (69 files), with no missing ⟦keys⟧. The new file `tools/tests/sim_persona_r5.test.js` has 10 tests and runs in about 1 s. `qa/full_campaign.mjs` at 1440×900 exited 0 with 0 confusing moments; I looked at the debrief screenshot and it is normal. The save/load determinism run (`sim.js campaign --seeds 2 --diff 0 --days 120 --det --save-mid`) exited 0. I changed no screens, so there were no layout screenshots to check.

**Finding 0 — Recruta first missions a massacre: fixed.**
- On Recruta, alien weapons now do 50 % damage to X-COM units (`TUNE.ALIEN_DAMAGE_PCT` [50,100,100]). Friendly fire, civilians and aliens still take full damage.
- A plasma pistol shot now kills a healthy rookie in coveralls about 11 % of the time instead of 55 %.
- Novice bot on a landed Large Scout (Recruta, month 0, 30 seeds): 93 % won with 2.37 dead per battle → 97 % with 1.73.
- For the debrief tip, the engine now records where each soldier fell, and the debrief has a new `clustered` count (soldiers killed close together in the same alien turn). Showing the tip is UI work; the patch is in open_issues.

**Finding 1 — recruits get pistols while Rocket Launchers sit in the stores: sim part done, UI patch needed.**
- The auto-kit lives in `campaign_ui.js`, which I don't own. I added `OV.Campaign.kitGuns`, which orders rifles first, then heavy weapons that have ammo (Rocket Launcher, cannons) by power, then pistols. The Tiago case now gives Rocket Launcher before pistol (tested).
- The one-line `autoKit` change and the briefing warning are in open_issues.

**Finding 2 — one Blaster shot from the ramp wins an alien base: fixed.**
- The Blaster bomb now only flies through tiles the squad has seen or discovered, like the original's waypoints. The persona's script now gets `noRoute` on turn 1 on all 10 seeds (it was 10/10 wins). The aiming preview uses the same check, so it no longer draws the route over unexplored tiles. Aliens are unchanged.
- The control centre is back to the original rule: destroying it does not end the battle. Aborting afterwards with someone aboard counts as a win (base destroyed, +500), with the normal abort recovery: only what is aboard comes home, soldiers left outside are missing.
- No surrender on that exit win.
- Players need a hint that leaving now wins; that battle HUD patch is in open_issues.

**Finding 3 — base defence a hidden all-or-nothing cliff: fixed.**
- Weapons now count: a rifle adds nothing, a laser rifle +15, a heavy plasma +42, an unarmed soldier −15. Unarmed defenders pick up the best guns with ammo from the base stores.
- The result is now a roll on the strength/need ratio instead of a threshold. At half the needed strength or less the base always falls; at 150 % or more it always holds. In between it can fall, repel, or hold at a cost.
  - Holding at a cost kills at least 60 % of the garrison but leaves at least one, and puts up to 2 radars or defences back under construction.
  - Example: 10 rookies against Mutons on Veterano, month 3: was lost 20/20, now about 40–52 % lost, 24–30 % repelled, 24–30 % held at a cost.
- One soldier plus Missile Defences still always loses.
- The new `OV.Campaign.defenceOdds` gives the UI the strength, the need, the odds and how many soldiers or defences are short. The Facilities bar and the attack warning are UI work; patches are in open_issues.

**Finding 4 — killed commander still surrenders: fixed differently from the proposal.**
- I did not apply «everyone killed ⇒ nobody surrenders». I measured it: with no surrender at all, the Veterano bot won 1/6 campaigns instead of 3/6, because it almost never stuns a commander and the story needs one.
- Instead, the surrender now comes from the base's command post, which is separate from the aliens in the battle. One commander and one leader surrender, and only when the base is taken by force (no conscious alien left, never on the exit win).
- Killing the battle commander no longer brings him back, and stunning him gives a second one.
- Documented in DESIGN §22 and CAMPAIGN_API §11.12; the r4 test was rewritten for this rule. The debrief text should say «posto de comando» (patch in open_issues).

**Finding 5 — January terror below the sim targets: fixed.**
- Month-0 terror sites now use the crew table one difficulty lower and one fewer terrorist (Veterano 4 aliens). Briefing estimates follow automatically.
- 30 seeds: Veterano 60 % won with 5.07 dead → 77 % with 3.8 (casualties still slightly above the ≤ 3 target); Super-humano 33 % with 6.9 → 57 % with 5.5.

**Campaign bot after all changes (240 days).**

| Difficulty | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Recruta, seeds 1–6 | — | 6/6 |
| Veterano, seeds 1–12 | 5/12 | 7/12 |
| Super-humano, seeds 1–6 | 0/6 | 1/6 |

- No council defeats and no base lost.
- Alien-base win rate dropped from 73 % to 55–62 % because the control centre no longer ends the battle.

I updated other tests in `tools/tests` that pinned the old rules (r1 Blaster route, r4 control centre and surrender, `campaign_pacing` base defence, `campaign_pacing2` month-0 terror, `battle_core` crew range now uses the month's table). Docs updated: CAMPAIGN_API §5.9, the events table, §8 tuning knobs, new §11.12, and a new persona round 5 block in DESIGN §22.
deviations: Finding 4: the persona asked that killing every alien means nobody surrenders. Applied literally (no surrender at all), the Veterano bot won 1/6 campaigns instead of 3/6. Instead the surrender is now the base's command post: one commander and one leader, separate from the battle crew, only when the base is taken by force, never on the control-centre exit. A killed commander no longer surrenders, and stunning him gives a second one. Documented in DESIGN §22 and CAMPAIGN_API §11.12.

Finding 2: the original rule is restored. Destroying the control centre no longer ends the battle; aborting afterwards wins (base destroyed, abort recovery rules). This replaces round 4's «ends at once», and the existing briefing and debrief texts need small i18n changes (open_issues).

Finding 3: the 'destroy some facilities' outcome does not demolish anything. The starting base is so compact that almost nothing can be dismantled, so up to 2 radars or defences go back under construction instead. Quarters, hangars, stores, labs, workshops and containment are never touched.
Finding 5: month-0 terror uses one difficulty lower plus one fewer terrorist (minimum 1). Veterano reaches 77 % won but still loses 3.8 soldiers per battle (target ≤ 3).

Finding 0: I used 50 % on Recruta instead of the suggested 75 %; at 75 % a plasma pistol still killed a rookie most of the time. The new debrief count is `debrief.clustered`; showing the tip is UI work.
open_issues: BATTLE FIXER (js/ui/battle_ui.js + js/i18n/pt-PT.battle.js). (1) After each player action/event, where `OV.Battle.outcome` is already checked: `if (!S.exitHinted && OV.Battle.exitWin && OV.Battle.exitWin(S.B)) { S.exitHinted = true; OV.Dom.toast(T('bs.obj.exitWin'), null, 'good'); }`. (2) In `abortMission()`: `const exit = OV.Battle.exitWin && OV.Battle.exitWin(S.B) && n > 0;` then the body text is `exit ? T('hud.abort.exitWin') : T('bs.abort.confirm')` and the confirm button is `{label: T(exit ? 'hud.abort.exitWinBtn' : …), kind: exit ? 'primary' : 'danger'}`. `finishBattle` already reads `B.result` ('win'). New keys: 'bs.obj.exitWin': 'Centro de controlo destruído! A base cai quando a equipa sair: reúna-a na zona de chegada e carregue em Abortar (X) — ou elimine os restantes alienígenas.'; 'hud.abort.exitWin': 'O centro de controlo está destruído: sair agora conta como VITÓRIA (base destruída). Quem não estiver na zona de chegada fica para trás.'; 'hud.abort.exitWinBtn': 'Sair — base destruída'. Change 'bs.noRoute' to 'Bomba sem rota até ao alvo pelas casas já vistas'.

SCREENS FIXER (js/ui/screens.js + js/i18n/pt-PT.screens.js). In `lossCauses()`, after the panic block add: `out.clustered = OV.Battle && OV.Battle.clusteredDeaths ? OV.Battle.clusteredDeaths(B) : 0; if (out.clustered >= 2 && best === 'enemy' && out.tip !== 'scr.db.tip.outnumbered') { if (!out.tip2) out.tip2 = out.tip; out.tip = 'scr.db.tip.clustered'; }`. New key 'scr.db.tip.clustered': 'Os soldados estavam todos juntos: o mesmo alienígena atingiu vários. Afaste-os 2 a 3 casas uns dos outros e avance em lanços.' Change 'scr.br.obj.alienBase.1' to 'Destruir o centro de controlo e sair (Abortar), ou eliminar todos os alienígenas da base.' and 'scr.db.objective' to 'Centro de controlo destruído: a equipa saiu e a base caiu; os alienígenas que restavam fugiram com o que levavam.'

SHELL/CAMPAIGN FIXER (js/ui/campaign_ui.js). In `autoKit`, replace `const guns = PREF_GUNS.concat(Object.keys(st).filter(...))` with `const guns = C().kitGuns ? C().kitGuns(G, st) : PREF_GUNS.concat(Object.keys(st).filter((id) => D().items[id] && D().items[id].kind === 'firearm' && PREF_GUNS.indexOf(id) < 0).sort((a, b) => weightOf(a) - weightOf(b)));`. The existing loop keeps the ammo and Strength checks, so a recruit gets a Rocket Launcher plus up to 2 rockets before a pistol (persona r5 finding 1). Also add the briefing AVISOS line for heavy weapons left at base, e.g. 'cp.br.leftHeavy': '{n} × {item} ficaram na base — E para levar' (opens the craft's equip screen); fits the leftAtBaseAll finding you already own. In js/i18n/pt-PT.campaign.js change 'cp.db.surrendered' to '{name} ×{n}: o posto de comando rendeu-se quando tomámos a base — para a contenção de {base}.'

BASE/GEO UI (js/ui/base_ui.js, js/ui/geo_ui.js, their i18n). In the Instalações tab, show `const o = OV.Campaign.defenceOdds(G, baseId)` as a bar «Defesa da base: força {o.strength} / exigida ≈ {o.need} ({raça}) — risco de perder a base {o.lostPct} %», with tone bad when lostPct > 0 and warn when holdPct > 0. In the 'baseAttack' popup use `defenceOdds(G, ev.baseId, {ufoId: ev.ufoId})`: when lostPct > 0 add 'geo.ev.baseAttack.short': 'Guarnição insuficiente: faltam ~{n} soldados' plus, if defencesShort > 0, ' (ou {m} Defesas de Mísseis)'. In the 'baseDefence' popup, when `ev.held`, add 'geo.ev.baseDefence.held': 'Aguentámos a custo: {list} ficaram destruídas e voltam a obra.' using `ev.facilitiesDamaged`. The result code stays 'repelled', so existing texts still render without the patch. When a damaged facility finishes rebuilding it fires the normal 'facilityDone' event (shown as construction completed).
